findings.detail: run signal handler sets outer stop only. A signal after loop check and before command installs ProcessOwner leaves stop pending while command may launch fresh V4 without observing it. Post-publish check occurs after transport completes.
findings.required: Preserve current source; share and check cancellation at ownership entry or raise immediately outside inner owner, plus actual signal controls around entry and restored-handler exit.
findings.scope: No native signal/execution; existing17 controls do not exercise this exact boundary.
